purpose: Machine-readable record of DeskMate releases, their installation media identity, and how far each has been qualified. Evidence states are cumulative and are never inferred from a source listing.

evidence_states.definition: Named in a period source, archive index, or catalog. No local media identity is established.
Original bytes are retained privately and recorded in a transfer receipt.
Archive size and SHA-256 match the recorded source receipt.
Selected payloads, signatures, FAT labels, or nested members were examined and described.
The distribution's own installer was executed and its prompts observed, without a completed installation.
A documented, observed installation completed on a stated environment and reached a working program.
A native first launch was observed from an installation or from documentation media and its version identity was recorded.
The installed release also survived a normal exit and a subsequent cold restart in the same environment.
